summary: An open, community-run live-streaming and tools network. Started in 2022 as a streaming site, re-architected in 2026 into seven services behind one identity provider. I design, build, deploy and operate all of it.
bullets: Architected the network as seven Node services with formal inter-service contracts: OpenVibe.Live (streaming), .Network (OIDC/OAuth2 identity, OpenCoins wallet, notifications, themes), .Media (multi-tenant media API), .Tools (169-tool suite), .Games (Scraplandia), .Community (pastes) and .Sites (13 front-page domains). About 363k lines, 900+ HTTP routes, one operator.

Built the streaming core: RTMP, WHIP and WebRTC-SFU ingest (mediasoup, werift), ffmpeg restream to Twitch, YouTube, Kick and SRT, VOD and clip pipelines with local → Backblaze B2 → Cloudflare R2 tiering, chat and moderation, a three-currency economy, PowerChat and RobotStreamer integrations, local whisper.cpp captions with LLM translation in about 21 languages, and AI clip and moment jobs on a provider-agnostic, budget-metered LLM client.

Ran it like a product team: systemd socket-activated zero-downtime deploys (measured 90 of 90 requests served through a restart), a deploy script that classifies each change and supports rollback, a headless-Chrome performance harness with interleaved A/B runs (home page CLS 0.83 → 0.03, warm FCP 1066 → 550 ms), and a dry-run migration suite plus cutover runbook that moved users, coins and 22 concurrent players with no downtime.
